answer_1.quote: We employ a visual question answering and explanation task: the input to the AI system is an image and a question in natural language, and its task is to generate an answer and a natural language explanation that justifies the answer.

answer_2.quote: To assess the construct validity of a representative automatic evaluation method, we compute BERTScores, measuring the similarity of ground truth explanations from both datasets to human evaluation scores.

answer_4.quote: We conducted the study online, using Prolific, and obtained ratings from 160 participants (80 each in Exp.A and X) who were native English speakers with normal color vision.
answer_4.guideline: Participants indicated their agreement on five-point Likert scales... for each criterion... they were asked to evaluate... correctness of the answer... in Exp.X... assess whether the explanation was (i) consistent with the answer, (ii) consistent with the picture, and (iii) overall fluent. Additionally... they were asked to judge whether they believed that the AI system correctly identifies (iv) shapes, (v) colors, and (vi) materials, as well as whether it (vii) understands the general scene in the image. Finally, (viii) participants judged the overall competence of the system.
